archiveMethod: Same prefix, fixed timestamp, per-entry explicit DEFLATE level9 and attributes as scripts/archive.py; final packaged bytes must match.
applicationByteScope: Sum of every application entry and generated shared JavaScript module exactly once; excludes separately counted vendor modules, engine loader and core JS.
feature: Explicit media URL copy in popup and app; independent implementation after five official repository comparisons.
functionality: Original FFmpeg binary and codecs retained; no permissions/CSP expansion, external runtime server or removal of scanning/verification.
scopeLimits: Byte savings are not end-to-end download or encoding speedups.
Brotli compression increases build CPU time and adds a small offline decoder and runtime memory.
The original FFmpeg runtime memory requirement and existing processing resource limits remain.
Actual installed-extension APIs, Windows AV and direct execution of Chrome120 are not verified here.

packagingCompression.priorBehavior: ZipFile global level9 was not inherited by custom ZipInfo; effective default6 corrected. Regression compares actual member raw compressed bytes with independent zlib9 output.

verification.note: Final packaging-only compression correction received a new regression test and all308 unit tests plus architecture/algorithm verification. Runtime dist and its successful browser/HTTP3 build identity were unchanged.
